intro.text: An Eelakin general who takes part in the talks with the Ones Above.

title.text: The talks with the Ones Above

items.text: Saplings feared the Ones Above would turn their overwhelming military might on the homeisles. When another offworlder offered to leave the Eelakin just one Aviar in a hundred, he angrily reached for his sidearm, and the newcomer summoned a strange weapon of his own in reply.

appearance.text: Keeps a grey and brown Aviar, and wears a repeating pistol holstered at his side.
